source_name: Bančni vestnik (Bank Association of Slovenia journal)
why_relevant: The only Slovenian monthly journal for money and banking, published since 1951 by Združenje bank Slovenije, with an English international issue each November. Author bylines and contributor affiliations are a reliable, low-noise indicator of who holds which senior role inside Slovenian banks over time.

source_name: SeeNews — Slovenia company news
why_relevant: SEE-focused business wire in English with a Slovenia company-news stream; reported the Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia CEO change (Mojca Kovač succeeding Luigi Fuzio, effective 16 March 2026). Best English bridge for foreign-owned bank subsidiaries.

source_name: FinTech Futures — 'Job cuts & new hires' section
why_relevant: A dedicated international appointments/redundancies column for banking & fintech that does pick up Slovenian items (covered Mojca Kovač becoming CEO of Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia). Exactly the 'appointments column' structure this cell targets, in English.

source_name: MQ portal / MQ revija (Združenje Manager)
why_relevant: Managers' Association of Slovenia media property (MQ magazine, ~1,600 manager readers, twice yearly; plus the portal). Profiles and 'Manager of the Year' coverage of banking executives (e.g. NLB's Blaž Brodnjak) give biographical depth and signal rising executives before they move.

source_name: Najdi.si novice — Slovenian news meta-search
why_relevant: Slovenian news aggregator/meta-search that indexes many outlets at once, including small regional and trade titles not otherwise on the radar. Useful as a discovery pointer for 'kadrovske spremembe'/'imenovanje' hits across the whole Slovenian press.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – About us / Organi (governance page)
why_relevant: Publishes the dated composition of the ZBS Supervisory Board (13 members + 13 deputies), each seat held by a named senior executive of a member bank (e.g. chairman from NLB, deputies from Delavska hranilnica and OTP banka). A change of the person occupying a bank's seat is a near-real-time proxy for a CEO/board change at that bank.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije – Members / Članice directory
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the Slovenian banking employer population: 13 banks and savings banks plus ~15 leasing companies. This is the seed list for every downstream employer-level jobs/leadership crawl in SI.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije – Izobraževalni center / Training Centre
why_relevant: Training catalogues reveal which competencies member banks are staffing up on (AML, ESG reporting, digital euro, payments) — a leading indicator of hiring themes before vacancies are posted. Trainer bios also name serving bank specialists.

source_name: Bančni vestnik (ZBS journal) – author and institutional affiliations
why_relevant: 70+ year-old sector journal whose article bylines carry current job titles and employers of Slovenian bankers and regulators — a dense, dated cross-check for who currently holds which senior/expert post.

source_name: ZBS ADR / out-of-court consumer dispute resolution page (mediators & member coverage)
why_relevant: Names the appointed mediators/ADR officers and lists which member institutions are bound to the scheme — an alternative, slower-moving index of the member population and of appointed association roles.

source_name: EU Transparency Register – ZBS datacard (via LobbyFacts)
why_relevant: Mandatory EU lobby-register filings disclose ZBS's declared headcount (FTEs), named legal representative and accredited persons, and budget — a rare hard number on the secretariat as an employer, updated at least annually.

source_name: GZS – Upravni odbor GZS (Chamber of Commerce and Industry management board)
why_relevant: Roster of the GZS management board, populated by CEOs of large Slovenian companies including financial-sector members; elections and co-optations are dated governance events usable as leadership-move signals.

source_name: GZS Media / Novice – chamber press releases on elections and appointments
why_relevant: Primary publisher of dated GZS governance news — e.g. the January 2026 election of Tibor Šimonka as GZS president and the board's appointment of Vesna Nahtigal to a four-year director-general mandate from 1 January 2027. Same channel announces sectoral-association (združenje) presidents, including finance-adjacent ones.

source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT), sections & membership
why_relevant: The GZS branch association closest to payments/fintech vendors: its membership and section pages point to the Slovenian ICT firms that supply banks, and its section leadership changes are appointment events. Nearest available substitute for a dedicated GZS financial-services fintech section.

source_name: AmCham Slovenia – Board of Governors
why_relevant: Named, dated board with explicit company affiliations, including financial-sector seats (e.g. NLB Skladi) and the CEO/president mandate (two-year terms). Board turnover and committee chair announcements are clean leadership-move records.

source_name: AmCham Slovenia – News feed and Membership directory
why_relevant: Publishes committee formation, chair appointments and member-company news; the membership page enumerates corporate members, including banks, insurers and payment/IT vendors operating in SI — a secondary employer-population pointer alongside ZBS.

source_name: Slovensko zavarovalno združenje (SZZ) – Organization / Organi združenja
why_relevant: Insurance-sector counterpart of ZBS. Its council appoints/dismisses the director and its working bodies are staffed by insurer executives — relevant because bancassurance and payments overlap the banking employer set. Statute (PDF) documents how appointments are made.

source_name: Združenje nadzornikov Slovenije (ZNS) – Organi ZNS
why_relevant: Slovenian Directors' Association governs the supervisory-board profession; its own officers are drawn from serving NS/UO members, and its library/positions track Bank of Slovenia fit-and-proper expectations for bank supervisory boards — directly relevant to who can be appointed where.

source_name: Združenje Manager – Upravni odbor
why_relevant: The senior-executive association: its board is a cross-sector list of serving CEOs with employer attribution, and its awards/news frequently mark a banker's move. Useful as a corroborating index for leadership moves discovered elsewhere.

source_name: Slovensko-nemška gospodarska zbornica (AHK Slovenija) – Upravni in nadzorni odbor
why_relevant: Bilateral chamber whose management and supervisory boards are confirmed annually at the member assembly, and whose newsroom publishes each new board member with name, role and employer — a dated, structured appointment stream covering German-linked corporates and their finance partners in SI.

source_name: Združenje poslovnih finančnikov Slovenije (ZPFS)
why_relevant: Association of corporate/business finance professionals; its officers, event speakers and 'Povezave' page function both as an appointment stream for finance-function leaders and as a curated pointer to other Slovenian finance bodies.

source_name: Blockchain Alliance Europe (Ljubljana) – members, events, leadership
why_relevant: The closest thing SI has to a fintech/crypto trade association: a non-profit alliance of companies using blockchain, active in the Slovenian Digital Coalition's blockchain working group and in digital-euro debate. Its member roster is a pointer to SI fintech/crypto employers; its officers are appointment events.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija (digitalna.si) – Delovne skupine
why_relevant: Lists the coalition's working groups and the member organisations staffing them (blockchain WG brings together Blockchain Think Tank Slovenia, Blockchain Alliance, Bitcoin Society, Slovenian Blockchain Association) — a compact map of SI digital-finance interest groups and their nominated representatives.

source_name: ZDU-GIZ – Združenje družb za upravljanje investicijskih skladov
why_relevant: Association of Slovenian asset-management companies (several bank-owned, e.g. NLB Skladi). Governance page and member list give both an appointment stream for asset-management leadership and a bank-affiliate employer pointer.

source_name: ACI Slovenia (financial markets association, national member of ACI FMA)
why_relevant: National association of treasury/FX and money-market dealers; national-association pages carry the elected president/committee and contact person, all of whom are serving bank treasury staff — a narrow but high-signal index of treasury leadership in SI banks.

source_name: Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije (OZS) – Organiziranost (skupščina, upravni odbor, nadzorni odbor, predsednik)
why_relevant: Craft & small-business chamber; matters for payments because its members are the merchant/acquiring population and it negotiates card-acceptance and cash-handling positions. Governance page is a dated officer roster.

source_name: O-STA press-release wire – association channel pages (e.g. ZNS)
why_relevant: Slovenian press-release distribution service where associations and chambers publish appointment/election releases verbatim and dated; often carries the announcement earlier and more completely than the association's own site.
